title: MathCoder2: Better Math Reasoning from Continued Pretraining on Model-translated Mathematical Code
authors_zh: Zimu Lu、Aojun Zhou、Ke Wang、Houxing Ren、Weikang Shi、Junting Pan、Mingjie Zhan、Hongsheng Li
paper_type_zh: 数学 continued-pretraining 数据构建、执行过滤与开放发布审计
best_for_zh: 研究模型翻译的数学代码、continued pretraining、程序执行筛选、混合数据配方，以及 partial release 的 sandbox、谱系、许可、去污染和版本绑定风险
one_line: MathCoder2 translates selected mathematical documents into conditions-expression-result-Python records, execution-filters and flattens them into MathCode-Pile, then uses the mixture for continued pretraining before separate supervised math post-training.
MathCoder2 将筛选后的数学网页翻译为“条件—表达式—结果—Python”记录，与网页、合成、代码和教材数据组成论文报告的 19,487,652 文档、19,184,073,343 token 的 MathCode-Pile；当前公开数据仍是只有 train split 的 partial text-only 版本，且执行过滤、谱系、许可、去污染和 checkpoint 绑定均不完整。
why: It shows executable mathematical-code translation as a continued-pretraining recipe while exposing why partial data, self-consistency verification, weak execution sandboxing, broken code paths, and missing provenance must be audited separately from paper-scale results.
inclusion_reason: MathCoder2 is an open construction recipe for combining filtered mathematical pretraining sources with LLM-translated executable records at reported 19.2B-token scale, with a clear audit boundary between the paper's execution contract and a partial, weaker, non-end-to-end public release.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative paper entry is the ICLR 2025 proceedings record, with the final 21-page paper and Appendices A-H published for ICLR 2025; OpenReview records the Spotlight status. MathCoder2 asks whether mathematical code can be made more useful for continued pretraining by pairing it with the mathematical context that ordinary code corpora often lack. Existing Python and Jupyter data may import mathematical libraries, yet much of it serves engineering, machine learning, or testing rather than explaining a mathematical computation.

The work builds MathCode-Pile, a reported 19,487,652-document, 19,184,073,343-token mixture. Its distinctive records are model-translated blocks containing natural-language conditions, a LaTeX computation expression, a teacher-stated result, and executable Python. Accepted blocks are flattened into text and mixed with filtered web documents, synthetic math/science text, code using mathematical packages, and online textbooks.

This belongs in Data Construction and Open Release Recipes because the research object is the source filtering, teacher translation, execution-based selection, flattening, decontamination, packaging, and checkpoint pipeline. It is not primarily an SFT-only corpus card, a standalone execution-verifier benchmark, or an RL recipe. The primary corpus use is continued causal-language-model pretraining, which the repository enum cannot represent directly. The Card retains sft only because the paper separately reports supervised math fine-tuning after continued pretraining; it does not relabel MathCode-Pile itself as an SFT dataset.

The L4 evidence boundary is analytic completeness, not release completeness. The final paper, appendices, official supplemental, project page, pinned code, partial Hugging Face data, and four continued-pretrained checkpoints were inspected. The current public release remains partial, text-only, and single-split; item-level provenance, rejected translations, execution observations, textbook manifests, source rights, and an end-to-end working pipeline are unavailable. Paper-scale construction and downloadable artifacts must therefore be audited separately.

权威论文入口是 ICLR 2025 proceedings record，21 页终版论文及 Appendices A-H 作为 ICLR 2025 论文发布；OpenReview 记录其 Spotlight 状态。MathCoder2 研究一个问题：通过为数学代码补充普通代码语料常常缺失的数学上下文，能否让它更适合 continued pretraining。现有 Python 与 Jupyter 数据即使导入数学库，也常用于工程、机器学习或测试，并不解释具体数学计算。

该工作构建 MathCode-Pile，论文报告其包含 19,487,652 个文档、19,184,073,343 个 token。最有辨识度的记录是模型翻译块，包含自然语言条件、LaTeX 计算表达式、teacher-stated result 和可执行 Python。通过筛选的块被压平成 text，再与筛选网页、合成数学/科学文本、使用数学包的代码和在线教材混合。

本文属于“数据构建与开放发布配方”，因为研究对象是 source filtering、teacher translation、execution-based selection、flattening、decontamination、packaging 与 checkpoint pipeline。它不是以 SFT-only corpus、独立 execution-verifier benchmark 或 RL recipe 为主。语料的主要用途是 continued causal-language-model pretraining，但当前仓库枚举没有对应值。本卡保留 sft，仅因为论文在 continued pretraining 后另行报告了监督式数学微调；不能因此把 MathCode-Pile 本身改写成 SFT 数据集。

这里的 L4 证据边界是分析完整度，而不是发布完整度。终版论文、appendix、官方 supplemental、project page、固定 revision 的代码、部分 Hugging Face 数据和四个 continued-pretrained checkpoint 均已检查。当前公开版本仍是 partial、text-only 且只有一个 split；item-level provenance、rejected translation、execution observation、textbook manifest、source right 与可端到端运行的 pipeline 均不可用。因此论文规模的构建过程与可下载工件必须分开审计。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is to translate mathematical prose into an interleaved reasoning-and-code pretraining object. Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct extracts the conditions required for a computation, its LaTeX expression and expected result, then writes an individually executable Python snippet. Execution filtering selects blocks before they are flattened and added to the basic mathematical corpus.

The full paper mixture has six components. Filtered OpenWebMath and filtered CC-En-math supply web text; three synthetic collections add structured math/science documents; StarCoderData contributes Python and Jupyter records importing selected mathematical packages; online PDFs provide textbooks; and the translation stage adds 2.7287B tokens of mathematical code paired with context.

The feedback object is not a learned reward. It is an execution-and-output selection predicate. At paper level, Python must run without error and match the extracted expected result. At code level, equality is tested only when both short strings parse numerically; other error-free outputs pass. Moreover, expected result and program originate in the same teacher completion, so the check measures internal consistency rather than independent mathematical correctness.

核心思路是把数学文本翻译为交错的“推理—代码”预训练对象。Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 提取计算所需条件、LaTeX 表达式和预期结果，再编写可独立执行的 Python 代码。执行筛选选择合格块，然后将其压平并加入基础数学语料。

论文中的完整混合包含六个组件。Filtered OpenWebMath 与 filtered CC-En-math 提供网页文本；三个合成集合提供结构化数学/科学文档；StarCoderData 提供导入指定数学包的 Python 与 Jupyter 记录；在线 PDF 提供教材；翻译阶段则新增 2.7287B token 的“数学上下文—代码”配对数据。

反馈对象不是 learned reward，而是执行与输出选择谓词。论文层面的要求是 Python 无错误运行并匹配提取出的预期结果；代码实现却只在两个短字符串都能解析为数值时检查相等，其他无错误输出直接通过。此外，预期结果与程序来自同一次 teacher completion，因此该检查衡量的是内部自洽，而不是独立数学正确性。

title: Method
方法
html:
MathCode-Pile's basic corpus combines five source classes before translation. Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct labels OpenWebMath documents, retaining mathematical problem/solution and concept/theory material. Common Crawl undergoes two fastText stages with intermediate Mixtral category annotation. Three synthetic collections are filtered for mathematical relevance. StarCoderData Python and Jupyter records are retained when they import packages such as sympy, fractions, cmath, scipy, or statistics; numpy alone is excluded as a filter. About 8K online textbook PDFs, reported exactly as 8,373 documents in Table 1, are selected by title keywords and converted with Nougat.

Released file-preparation code sends selected filtered OpenWebMath and CC-En-math records to Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. Generation is greedy, truncates source input at 3,072 tokens, allows 3,072 new tokens, and uses 12 local workers. The structured completion contains Conditions Needed, a LaTeX expression, Computation Result, and Python. The paper and deployment script identify Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct as translator; the mathematical-code README's Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct attribution conflicts with them.

Python is run through raw exec in worker processes with a ten-second timeout. Regex checks block input( and os.system(, but do not form a hardened filesystem, network, subprocess, or import sandbox. The intended filter retains code that executes without error and matches the expected result. The released comparator applies an absolute-error threshold of 0.01 only when output and expected result are both shorter than 20 characters and complex-parseable. Otherwise, any error-free execution enters the accepted set.

After filtering, title, conditions, expression, result, and fenced code are concatenated into one text document. Generation fields, stdout, exceptions, timeouts, numeric comparisons, and rejection reasons disappear. Exact matching and 13-gram Jaccard similarity above 0.6 are reported for decontamination against nine bundled benchmark test sources, after which four bases undergo three epochs of continued pretraining with a four-million-token global batch.

Table 1 reports six exact components: filtered OpenWebMath 4,826,902,621 tokens; filtered CC-En-math 6,341,745,645; synthetic data 2,193,189,314; math-package code 1,703,226,005; textbooks 1,390,268,773; and translated code 2,728,740,985. The total is 19,487,652 documents and 19,184,073,343 tokens. These are paper-corpus counts, not counts of the current Hugging Face snapshot.

The public dataset has one train split and one text field per row. Its card explicitly says OpenWebMath, CC-En-math, and translated code are only partly released. No textbook-specific directory is identifiable. Public rows omit source URL/license, filter score, teacher/version, execution evidence, and contamination decision. Four continued-pretrained checkpoints are public; the later NuminaMath CoT/TIR SFT checkpoints used in downstream experiments are not in the official collection.

MathCode-Pile 在翻译前先组合五类基础来源。Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct 标注 OpenWebMath 文档，保留数学问题/解答和概念/理论内容。Common Crawl 经过两轮 fastText，并在中间使用 Mixtral 做类别标注。三个合成集合按数学相关性过滤。StarCoderData 的 Python 与 Jupyter 记录只有在导入 sympy、fractions、cmath、scipy、statistics 等包时才保留，单独出现 numpy 不作为过滤依据。约 8K 份在线教材 PDF 按标题关键词选择，表 1 精确报告 8,373 个文档，并用 Nougat 转换。

公开的文件准备代码将筛选后的 OpenWebMath 与 CC-En-math 记录送入 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct。生成采用 greedy decoding，源输入截断到 3,072 token，最多生成 3,072 token，使用 12 个本地 worker。结构化 completion 包含 Conditions Needed、LaTeX 表达式、Computation Result 和 Python。论文与部署脚本都将 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 标为翻译 teacher；数学代码 README 写成 Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct，与二者冲突。

Python 在 worker process 中通过 raw exec 执行，timeout 为十秒。正则只屏蔽 input( 和 os.system(，并未构成面向文件系统、网络、子进程和 import 的 hardened sandbox。预期过滤规则是代码无错误执行且输出匹配预期结果。公开 comparator 只有在输出和预期结果都短于 20 字符且可解析为 complex number 时，才使用 0.01 的 absolute-error threshold；其他情况只要无执行错误就进入 accepted set。

筛选后，标题、条件、表达式、结果和 fenced code 被拼接为单个 text 文档。生成字段、stdout、exception、timeout、数值比较和拒绝理由全部消失。论文报告使用 exact match 与 13-gram Jaccard 大于 0.6，对九类 bundled benchmark test source 做去污染；随后四个基础模型使用四百万 token 的 global batch，进行三轮 continued pretraining。

表 1 报告六个精确组件：filtered OpenWebMath 4,826,902,621 token；filtered CC-En-math 6,341,745,645；synthetic data 2,193,189,314；math-package code 1,703,226,005；textbooks 1,390,268,773；translated code 2,728,740,985。总计 19,487,652 个文档、19,184,073,343 个 token。这是论文语料的统计，不是当前 Hugging Face snapshot 的统计。

公开数据集只有一个 train split，每行只有一个 text 字段。其 dataset card 明确说明 OpenWebMath、CC-En-math 与 translated code 仅 partial release，也找不到教材专用目录。公开行缺少 source URL/license、filter score、teacher/version、执行证据和 contamination decision。四个 continued-pretrained checkpoint 已公开；下游实验使用的 NuminaMath CoT/TIR SFT checkpoint 不在官方 collection 中。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper separates the 16.5B-token basic corpus from the 2.7287B-token translated-code addition. On Llama-3-8B continued pretraining, adding translated code reports 38.4% four-shot MATH and 69.9% GSM8K, improvements of 3.1 and 4.1 points over training on the basic corpus alone. Four different 7B/8B base families improve on the reported average across five mathematical benchmarks.

The authors then perform supervised fine-tuning: two epochs on general mathematical instructions followed by three epochs on NuminaMath CoT or TIR. Results support the claim that continued-pretrained checkpoints can enter later mathematical post-training, but they combine corpus, optimizer, SFT data, decoding, and evaluation choices. They do not prove that every released document is correct or that the public snapshot reproduces the paper corpus.

The execution evidence is weaker than the paper's prose suggests. Running teacher-generated Python can reject syntax and runtime failures, but the expected result and program share one author. The checked code also skips equality comparison for long or nonnumeric outputs. Passing therefore cannot be interpreted as an independent proof that the extracted source mathematics or reasoning steps are valid.

Appendix H reports overlap decreasing from 0.21% at 3-grams to 0.00% at 13-grams. This is aggregate author-reported evidence, not a released per-match ledger. The public decontamination code expects a different field and emits a different object shape from the current text-only release, so the hosted decontaminated files are not transparently reconstructed by the checked script.

论文区分 16.5B-token 基础语料与新增的 2.7287B-token translated code。对 Llama-3-8B 做 continued pretraining 时，加入 translated code 后四样本 MATH 为 38.4%、GSM8K 为 69.9%，比只训练基础语料分别提升 3.1 与 4.1 个百分点。四类 7B/8B 基础模型在五个数学 benchmark 的报告平均值上都得到提升。

作者随后进行监督式微调：先在通用数学 instruction 上训练两轮，再在 NuminaMath CoT 或 TIR 上训练三轮。这些结果支持 continued-pretrained checkpoint 可以进入后续数学 post-training，但它们同时包含语料、optimizer、SFT 数据、decoding 和评测选择，不能证明每个公开文档都正确，也不能证明当前 public snapshot 可复现论文语料。

执行证据比论文文字表述更弱。运行 teacher-generated Python 可以排除语法和运行时失败，但预期结果与程序由同一个 teacher 生成。核查的代码还会跳过长输出或非数值输出的相等性比较。因此，通过筛选不能解释为对源数学含义或推理步骤有效性的独立证明。

附录 H 报告 overlap 从 3-gram 的 0.21% 降到 13-gram 的 0.00%。这是作者报告的聚合证据，不是公开的逐匹配账本。公开去污染代码期望的字段和输出对象形状都与当前 text-only release 不一致，因此核查脚本无法透明重建托管的 decontaminated 文件。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is not code pretraining or program execution alone. MathCoder2 constructs mathematical code from mathematical prose, preserving the conditions, symbolic expression, stated result, and executable implementation as one interleaved pretraining document. This targets code that explains a computation rather than unrelated software that merely imports a mathematical package.

The broader recipe is also unusually explicit at paper level: two-stage web filtering, synthetic and package-code sources, PDF textbook extraction, model translation, execution filtering, decontamination, a six-component mixture, and continued pretraining across four base-model families. The translated component is evaluated as an additive corpus intervention rather than only as instruction-tuning data.

Its novelty must be separated from release completeness. The hosted row collapses rich generation-time structure into text, the public corpus is explicitly partial, and the checked verification pipeline is weaker and less executable than the prose contract. For the track, this makes MathCoder2 both a continued-pretraining recipe and a case study in how a documented pipeline can lose auditability at packaging time.

该工作的辨识度不只是代码预训练或程序执行。MathCoder2 从数学文本构造数学代码，把计算条件、符号表达式、声明结果和可执行实现保存在同一交错预训练文档中。它针对的是解释数学计算的代码，而不是仅仅导入数学包、但服务于其他软件任务的代码。

论文层面的整体配方也较完整：两阶段网页过滤、合成与数学包代码来源、PDF 教材抽取、模型翻译、执行筛选、去污染、六组件混合，以及跨四类基础模型的 continued pretraining。Translated component 被作为增量语料干预进行评测，而不只是 instruction-tuning 数据。

新意必须与发布完整性分开。托管数据行把丰富的生成期结构压缩为 text，公开语料明确是 partial，核查后的验证 pipeline 也比论文契约更弱、更难端到端执行。对本轨道而言，MathCoder2 既是一项 continued-pretraining 配方，也是“记录充分的流程如何在封装发布时失去可审计性”的案例。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The public release is not the full Table 1 corpus. Hugging Face exposes a single train split with partial OpenWebMath, CC-En-math, and translated-code shards, no identifiable textbook directory, and no row-level provenance. Its preview estimate is not a complete document count. Source URLs, upstream revisions, filter scores, teacher fields, execution evidence, and rejected records are absent.

Verification is self-consistency with a weak implementation boundary. Expected result and Python come from one Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct completion. Only two short numeric-parseable strings receive the 0.01 tolerance comparison; other error-free outputs pass. Raw exec, a timeout, and two regex blocks are not a secure sandbox for generated code.

The checked pipeline is not end-to-end executable without repair. Execution and conversion scripts import an absent module; one calls an undefined entry point; generation and parsing disagree about a required model field; OpenWebMath filtering references undefined idx; and the training resume branch references new_learning_rate before assignment. These defects do not show that the authors' original runs failed, but they block transparent replay of the public artifact.

Decontamination is not reproducibly bound to the release. The public script expects an output field while hosted rows use text, uses substring matching in its exact stage, and emits a tuple-shaped accepted object. Benchmark revisions, candidate matches, decisions, and semantic-overlap review are absent.

Rights and versions remain unresolved. The dataset and checkpoint pages declare Apache-2.0, but the GitHub root has no license. No row-level license ledger covers Common Crawl, OpenWebMath, StarCoderData, synthetic sources, or unlisted textbook PDFs. Code and data revisions predate the ICLR 2025 Spotlight decision, have no named paper release, and are not bound to exact paper-run configurations or checkpoint hashes. The official collection releases four continued-pretrained models but not the downstream CoT/TIR SFT variants.

公开版本不是表 1 的完整语料。Hugging Face 只有一个 train split，OpenWebMath、CC-En-math 和 translated code 只发布部分 shard，没有可识别的教材目录，也没有逐行 provenance。其 viewer estimate 不能当作完整文档数。Source URL、上游 revision、filter score、teacher field、执行证据和被拒记录都缺失。

验证本质是自洽检查，而且实现边界较弱。预期结果和 Python 来自同一次 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct completion。只有两个短且可解析为数值的字符串才执行 0.01 tolerance 比较；其他无错误输出直接通过。Raw exec、timeout 和两个正则屏蔽并不是执行生成代码的安全 sandbox。

核查的 pipeline 未经修复无法端到端执行。执行与转换脚本导入不存在的 module；其中一处调用未定义入口；生成与解析脚本对必需的 model 字段不一致；OpenWebMath filtering 引用未定义 idx；训练 resume 分支在赋值前引用 new_learning_rate。这些缺陷不能证明作者原始运行失败，却阻碍公开工件的透明重放。

去污染没有与公开版本形成可复现绑定。公开脚本期望 output 字段，而托管数据使用 text；exact stage 实际采用 substring matching；accepted object 又是 tuple shape。Benchmark revision、候选匹配、判断结果和语义重叠复核均未公开。

权利与版本仍未解决。数据集和 checkpoint 页面声明 Apache-2.0，但 GitHub 根目录没有 license。没有逐行 license ledger 覆盖 Common Crawl、OpenWebMath、StarCoderData、合成来源或未列出的教材 PDF。代码和数据 revision 早于 ICLR 2025 Spotlight 决定，没有命名的 paper release，也未绑定论文运行配置或 checkpoint hash。官方 collection 发布四个 continued-pretrained model，却未发布下游 CoT/TIR SFT 版本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Data Construction & Open Release Recipes track, MathCoder2 is useful for decomposing a continued-pretraining mixture into source filtering, translation, execution selection, packaging, decontamination, training, and release. Its six-component table gives exact document and token denominators that can anchor replications without conflating the reported corpus with the partial snapshot.

A safer implementation should retain structured fields rather than only flattened text: source URL and revision, source-specific license, filter model and score, teacher checkpoint and prompt, conditions, expression, expected result, code, stdout, exception/timeout, comparison type and tolerance, acceptance/rejection reason, decontamination matches, and final shard/checkpoint binding. Independent symbolic or human checks are needed if mathematical validity matters beyond teacher-program consistency.

Generated code should run in an isolated, resource-limited sandbox without filesystem or network access, with explicit import policy and reproducible dependencies. The public pipeline defects and decontamination schema mismatch should be repaired and covered by an end-to-end test before reproduction claims.

The public snapshot can support qualitative corpus inspection, partial continued-pretraining experiments, and checkpoint comparison after rights and overlap review. It should not be described as the complete 19.184B-token release, a fully verified reasoning corpus, or a byte-reproducible training bundle. Benchmark gains are evidence of utility in the reported setup, not certification of data correctness, safety, provenance, or license compatibility.

对“数据构建与开放发布配方”轨道而言，MathCoder2 适合用来把 continued-pretraining mixture 拆解为来源过滤、翻译、执行选择、封装、去污染、训练和发布。六组件表提供精确文档数与 token 分母，可为复现实验提供锚点，同时避免把论文语料与 partial snapshot 混为一谈。

更安全的实现应保留结构化字段，而不只是 flattened text：source URL 与 revision、source-specific license、filter model 与 score、teacher checkpoint 与 prompt、conditions、expression、expected result、code、stdout、exception/timeout、comparison type 与 tolerance、接受/拒绝理由、decontamination match，以及最终 shard/checkpoint 绑定。如果需要超越 teacher-program consistency 的数学有效性，还应加入独立符号检查或人工审计。

生成代码应运行在隔离且资源受限的 sandbox 中，禁止文件系统与网络访问，明确 import policy，并固定依赖。公开 pipeline 缺陷与去污染 schema mismatch 应先修复，再用端到端测试覆盖，之后才能提出复现声明。

公开 snapshot 经权利与 overlap 审查后，可用于定性语料检查、部分 continued-pretraining 实验和 checkpoint 对比。它不能被描述为完整 19.184B-token release、完全验证的推理语料或 byte-reproducible training bundle。Benchmark 提升只能证明方案在报告设置下有用，不能认证数据正确性、安全性、provenance 或 license compatibility。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The official decision is ICLR 2025 Spotlight; use the proceedings author order, while noting that the PDF swaps Ke Wang and Houxing Ren.
  • Read Table 1 as six exact paper-corpus components totaling 19,487,652 documents and 19,184,073,343 tokens, not as statistics of the current partial Hugging Face snapshot.
  • Keep the intended verifier distinct from code: paper prose requires execution and expected-result match, whereas implementation compares only short numeric outputs within 0.01 and otherwise accepts error-free execution.
  • The translation teacher is Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct according to the paper and deployment script; the README's Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct statement is conflicting metadata.
  • Before reuse, audit the weak sandbox, broken pipeline paths, text-only provenance loss, missing textbook release, decontamination schema mismatch, root-code license gap, and continued-pretrained versus SFT checkpoint boundary.

• 官方决定是 ICLR 2025 Spotlight；作者顺序采用 proceedings 元数据，同时注意 PDF 将 Ke Wang 与 Houxing Ren 的顺序对调。

value.html: MathCode-Pile is a document-level continued-pretraining mixture. A translated mathematical-code record pairs natural-language conditions and a LaTeX computation expression with a teacher-stated result and executable Python, then flattens the accepted block into one public text field.

The basic corpus combines filtered OpenWebMath, filtered English Common Crawl, three synthetic math/science collections, StarCoderData Python and Jupyter records importing selected mathematical packages, and online mathematical textbooks converted from PDFs. Released translation code applies the translation stage to filtered OpenWebMath and CC-En-math.

conditions needed for computation
LaTeX computation expression
teacher-stated expected result
individually executable Python code

value.html: The executor captures stdout or an exception/timeout. These observations and rejection reasons are not retained in public one-field rows.

Generation uses a labelled Conditions Needed, expression, result, and fenced-Python block. After parsing and filtering, the release concatenates title, conditions, expression, result, and code into unstructured text.

Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct translates selected mathematical prose into conditions-expression-result-Python blocks. The public mathematical-code README names Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct, but the paper and deployment script identify Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct.

value.html: Python runs through raw exec in worker processes with a ten-second timeout. Regex blocks input( and os.system(, but the implementation is not a comprehensive filesystem, network, subprocess, or import sandbox.

A deterministic execution-and-comparison selection filter, not a learned reward. Because the same teacher completion authors expected result and program, passing demonstrates teacher-program self-consistency rather than independent verification of the source mathematics.

The paper describes error-free execution plus expected-result matching. Released code only compares outputs when both short strings parse as complex numbers, accepting absolute error at most 0.01; otherwise an error-free execution is classified as correct without content comparison.
Intended: Python runs without error and stdout matches expected result. Implemented: execution is error-free and, only for two short complex-parseable strings, absolute difference is at most 0.01.

The current Hugging Face revision exposes one train split of text-only rows. It explicitly releases only part of filtered OpenWebMath, filtered CC-En-math, and translated code; no identifiable textbook directory or row-level provenance is present.

Web, synthetic, code, and textbook sources -> source-specific filtering -> 16.5B-token basic corpus -> Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct translation -> parsing and Python execution filtering -> flattening -> exact/13-gram decontamination -> reported 19.184B-token MathCode-Pile -> continued pretraining of four 7B/8B bases.
Continued pretraining covers Llama-3-8B, DeepSeekMath-7B, Mistral-7B, and CodeLlama-7B. The paper later applies supervised fine-tuning.

Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct authors translated mathematical-code blocks. Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct labels web documents and finer Common Crawl categories; two fastText classifiers implement scalable CC filtering.
Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct greedily emits conditions, a LaTeX expression, expected result, and executable Python for each source document.
Selected filtered OpenWebMath and filtered CC-En-math records in the released file-preparation code.
Translation uses greedy decoding, source truncation at 3,072 tokens, up to 3,072 new tokens, and Llama end-of-turn stopping. The script launches 12 local workers.

unknown
No tree search or repair loop; one teacher completion is structurally parsed and passed to an execution filter.

Paper: error-free execution with output matching expected result. Code: absolute error at most 0.01 only for two short numeric-parseable strings; other error-free outputs are accepted without equality checking.

OpenWebMath retains Mixtral-labelled mathematical problem/solution or concept/theory documents. CC uses two fastText stages with intermediate Mixtral categorization. Code must import selected math packages. Translated blocks are parsed, executed, filtered, then decontaminated.
No reward optimization; verification is a binary corpus-selection filter.
unknown
Generation seeds are unknown. The Llama pretraining example uses seed 3407.
A 6,144-token serving limit is configured. Total requests, failures, retries, accepted records, and aggregate compute are unknown.

Continued pretraining runs three epochs with four-million-token global batch. Llama-3 uses context 8,192 and other bases 4,096. The Llama example uses 32 A800 GPUs, learning rate 4e-5, cosine schedule, warmup 50, weight decay 0.1, BF16, gradient checkpointing, and seed 3407. Downstream validation uses two epochs general math-instruction SFT then three epochs NuminaMath CoT or TIR SFT; no RL or preference optimization is reported.

Six Table 1 components are filtered OpenWebMath (4,826,902,621 tokens), filtered CC-En-math (6,341,745,645), synthetic data (2,193,189,314), code importing mathematical packages (1,703,226,005), online mathematical textbooks (1,390,268,773), and translated mathematical code (2,728,740,985). Total: 19,487,652 documents and 19,184,073,343 tokens.
Current Hugging Face exposes one train split with no validation/test or source-grouped partitions. Benchmark test files support decontamination, not dataset evaluation splits.
Checked tests include GSM8K, MATH, MMLU-Math, OCW, SAT-Math, Hungarian, mathematics, OlympiadBench, and SVAMP. Exact revisions/checksums and a semantic-contamination audit are not documented.

The paper reports exact matching plus 13-gram Jaccard similarity above 0.6 against evaluation questions. Per-match decisions are absent, and the public script's field assumptions/output shape do not align with current text-only rows.
Public records retain accepted flattened text only. Generation fields, stdout, exceptions, timeouts, comparison values, rejections, filter scores, and decontamination matches are unavailable.
